wallet.title: Card Setup
wallet.subtitle: Select a target card and apply new artwork
wallet.staticHelp: PNG / JPG / WebP; the integrated designer crops first, then produces correct @3x and @2x assets.
wallet.reopenWallet: Force-close Apple Wallet and reopen it after applying artwork.
wallet.restorePdfHelp: Writes only cardBackgroundCombined.pdf and refreshes Wallet caches. PNG/pass.json/manifest.json are untouched.
wallet.needDeviceCard: Need: connected iPhone and selected card hash

designer.title: Card Designer
designer.subtitle: Layer-based Wallet artwork editor. Every object can be selected and moved independently. Output: @3x 1536×969, @2x 1024×646 and PDF.
designer.name: Layer name
designer.canvasHint: Click an object to select it, then drag only that object. Drag empty canvas to pan the background. Mouse wheel scales the selected layer/background.

passcode.title: Passcode Theme
passcode.subtitle: Apply Cowabunga / Nugget lock-screen keypad themes
passcode.packageHelp: Select a .passthm package containing keypad artwork
passcode.targetHelp: Choose the cache format for the iPhone iOS version
passcode.languageHelp: Keypad subtext language; Universal includes Chinese locales
passcode.boldHelp: Also generates *-bold.png when iOS Bold Text is enabled
passcode.afterApply: Lock the iPhone after applying to view the new keypad.

help.title: Setup & Card Hash Guide
help.subtitle: How to connect your iPhone and capture a card hash
help.prereq1: - Install 64-bit iTunes or Apple Mobile Device Support
help.prereq2: - First use: connect by USB and tap “Trust This Computer” on iPhone
help.prereq3: - Wi-Fi: enable Wi-Fi sync first and keep PC/iPhone on the same LAN
help.prereq4: - Choose Auto, USB only, or Wi-Fi only from the top bar
help.hash1: 1. Click Scan on the Wallet tab
help.hash3: 3. Select the card you want to modify
help.hash4: 4. AirCard automatically captures the card hash
help.hash5: 5. Click Stop after the card is detected
help.applySubtitle: Apply Wallet artwork and passcode themes
help.wallet1: 1. Import an image, crop it in the designer, then choose “Use this design as Wallet artwork”
help.wallet2: 2. Click Apply Static Artwork and wait for completion
help.wallet4: 4. Reopen Wallet to view the new artwork
help.theme1: - Compatible with Cowabunga and Nugget theme packages
help.theme4: - Lock the screen after applying to verify the new keypad artwork

status.ready: Ready. Connect iPhone by USB or paired Wi-Fi and keep it unlocked.
status.noDevice: No iPhone found over USB or paired Wi-Fi.
status.needHash: Enter or scan a target card hash first.
status.restoredPdf: Original Wallet PDF restored. Force-close Wallet and reopen it.
status.scanning: Scanning system logs… Open Wallet or select the card on iPhone.
